Our Therapists

Our Therapists

Victoria Aspring

With over 9 years of experience in Ayurveda, naturopathy, craniosacral therapy, and advanced massage techniques, she has helped more than 950 clients move from pain and stress to energy and balance.

Her unique approach combines the wisdom of Eastern medicine with modern therapeutic methods. That’s why women navigating pregnancy or hormonal changes, children and families in need of gentle care, professionals facing burnout, and athletes seeking faster recovery all trust her expertise.

As a certified RMT and naturopath, and a member of major Canadian and Quebec associations, Victoria ensures her clients not only feel immediate relief but also achieve visible results within 3–4 months.

Clients say that in her hands, they don’t just relax — they heal, restore, and discover new energy for life.

Registered Massage Therapist, Certified Naturopath

Halina Aspring

Registered Massage Therapist in Montreal

Halina is a skilled and caring massage therapist from Ukraine specializing in therapeutic and deep tissue massage. With a gentle touch and strong techniques, she helps clients release muscle tension, improve circulation, and restore balance. Known for her professionalism and warm personality, Halina creates a safe, relaxing space where every client feels supported and renewed.
